verdict.rationale: The probes show only that the ANEF portal returns a roughly 3 KB JavaScript shell with under 200 characters of readable text, and that the parent ministry site blocks keyless agents behind a Cloudflare challenge. No published page content was retrievable that documents a founder completing an application, filing or payment online. The probe's note that transactions sit behind an account is an observer's characterization, not the service's own published statement, so the story is unevidenced.

support.subject: As a founder, the core transaction this service exists for (form, register, apply, file, or pay) can be completed online, per the service's own published pages
